label: Deep refresh across all criteria (11 Nov 2026)
description: Multi-language sweep across every catalog topic, 11 Nov 2026. Focus on titles new since 4 Nov 2026, plus vertical dramas and non-English works. Adults only; non-explicit notes; every entry sourced with a confidence label. This file was created at the start of the run so the weekly routine can see the refresh is in progress.

records.title: 被催眠的她 (Lin Xiaowan / Jiang Lin)
records.meta: China · Mandarin · 60 episodes · listings updated 31 Oct 2026 (distinct from the April 2026 Zhang Qing series of the same Chinese title)
records.summary: After three years of marriage, Lin Xiaowan secretly visits hypnotist Jiang Lin to treat her husband's insomnia; after the first session her manner changes, she addresses her husband as "master," cannot remember what she has done, and repeats secrets only Jiang Lin would know.
records.evidence: Platform synopses naming the same couple and hypnotist

records.meta: China · Mandarin · 汉鲸文化 · 60 episodes · first aired 9 Oct 2026
records.character: Dai Jia (CEO of Jiajia Group, wife of Cheng Xianghu)
records.summary: After her husband betrays her and tries to kill her, CEO Dai Jia is rescued by her former love, a hypnotist, who finds that the husband had used hypnosis to alter her memories of their earlier relationship; they work to restore her memory and expose the plot.

records.kids_note: Synopsis says she later reclaims her child; the child's age is not stated.
